question: Machines, tools and Implements, and buildings are examples of which type of goods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capital goods.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Machines, tools, and implements, and buildings are examples of** capital goods.**
 
• **Capital goods** are the goods that are used in the **production of other goods and services.**
